name: Packaging and corrugation

problems.words: Dies and plates can't be found when the repeat order comes
quick_ideas: Label every die and plate once with customer and job, so they can be found
Give each customer a fixed shelf

workzap_build.text: A die and plate register with storage location, condition and customer, searchable on phone.

problems.ask_first: How often does a repeat order need a new plate?
problems.free_stops: Coding and storage layout are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the die and plate area and note how many repeat jobs needed a search this week, so delays on reruns are clear.
Give one store person one notebook for every die and plate movement, so repeat orders stop waiting for searches.

problems.words: Boxes made in the wrong size or ply
quick_ideas: Check the next job order against the customer's approved spec before it goes to the floor
Note where the last few mistakes started

workzap_build.text: A digital job order with size, ply, flute, paper grade, print and die and plate references, sent to the floor from the approved spec.

problems.ask_first: Do the wrong sizes come mostly from the order form, or from the machine setup?
problems.free_stops: How job orders flow from sales to machines is covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many jobs this week reached the floor with size or ply corrected later, so where orders drift gets clearer.
Give one supervisor the job of marking size and ply on one floor list before running, so wrong boxes reach machines less often.

problems.words: Paper reel prices change every month and contracts are fixed
quick_ideas: Work out cost per box at today's paper rate for your top customers' boxes
Compare it with what you charge

workzap_build.text: A quote calculator using live paper rates, board area, wastage allowance and printing costs.

problems.ask_first: Are your prices fixed with customers for months, or only per order?
problems.free_stops: How the cost is built and updated is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note this month's paper reel rate beside each fixed contract job you actually ran, so the most squeezed work shows clearly.
Give one person one notebook page for paper reel rate changes and related contract jobs, so quotation talks use the latest rate.

problems.words: Kraft paper short in the market, we can't start the job
quick_ideas: Count reel stock once by GSM, BF and width
Match it against this month's jobs, so shortages show early

workzap_build.text: A reel stock register by GSM, BF, width and supplier with consumption per job and reorder alerts.

problems.ask_first: Is the paper shortage in one grade or width, or across several?
problems.free_stops: How consumption and reorder levels are worked out is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare kraft reels on hand with jobs waiting to start this week, so stoppages from missing paper show up earlier.
Give one store person one board for incoming reels and waiting jobs, so production sees shortages before the machine sits idle.

problems.words: Trim and setup waste too high
quick_ideas: Weigh trim and setup waste per machine for one week
Note which jobs create the most

workzap_build.text: A production log per machine for output, setup and trim waste and downtime reasons.

problems.ask_first: Does the waste come mostly from setup at job changes, or from trim?
problems.free_stops: How waste is measured and compared is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note trim and setup waste beside each job for one shift on each machine, so the worst waste patterns show.
Give one shift lead one waste notebook kept at the machine, so trim and setup loss gets recorded every run.

problems.words: Waste paper sold, money and weight don't match
quick_ideas: Weigh the next waste load yourself before it leaves
Route waste sales through the office only

workzap_build.text: A waste paper weighing and sales register matched with gate passes.

problems.ask_first: Is the mismatch in the weight, or in the money received?
problems.free_stops: Weighing and matching steps are covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note the next waste loads by vehicle, weight and buyer type before they leave, so mismatches with the yard record stand out.
Give one office person one yard register for every waste load leaving the gate, so each movement gets checked in one place.

quick_ideas: List every customer with what is due and since when
Follow up on the oldest few this week

workzap_build.text: A customer ledger with ageing, credit limits and WhatsApp reminders.

problems.ask_first: Do the late payers include a few large customers, or many?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and limits are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which large customer invoices stayed open past the promised date this month, so the slowest paying customer type becomes visible.
Give one office person one weekly slot to mark promised dates against open invoices, so late accounts are spotted before dispatch arguments grow.

problems.words: Quotes take a day because only one person can calculate them
quick_ideas: Write down the rates and allowances that person uses
Let a second person prepare quotes for review

workzap_build.text: A quote calculator anyone in sales can use, with approval in one tap.

problems.ask_first: Does quoting wait for that one person mostly on new box designs, or on repeat jobs too?
problems.free_stops: How the calculator is set up is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many quote requests waited for that one calculator this week, so the delay from single person dependence is visible.
Give one backup staff member one notebook of live quote workings for review, so customer replies need not wait a full day.

problems.words: Monthly production and waste report is done in Excel by hand
quick_ideas: Decide the few numbers you actually need each month

workzap_build.text: A monthly owner report on output, waste, top customers by volume and margin, and overdues, prepared for you.

problems.ask_first: Does the report take long in gathering the numbers, or in putting them together?
problems.free_stops: Which numbers go in and where each comes from is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which production and waste numbers are chased from people at month end, so the reporting delay shows by source.
Give one person one daily page for production and waste totals by machine, so month end reporting stops being rebuilt by hand.

never_say: Any advice on food-contact, pharma or dangerous goods packaging compliance, or box strength specifications for regulated shipments.
Any help copying another brand's packaging or printing counterfeit branded boxes.
Fake invoices, under-invoicing or misdeclaring imported reels.
Any judgement on liability for weak boxes; note the testing and records gap only.
Ink or adhesive chemistry; steam burns and godown fires are emergencies.
Storing customer contacts or worker identities.

sample_reply.person: Repeat order aata hai to purana die aur plate dhoondne mein aadha din lagta hai, kabhi milta hi nahi. Iska koi hal?
sample_reply.pi:
Ji haan, shuruaat chhoti si ho sakti hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, har die aur plate pe ek dafa customer aur job ka label laga dein, taa ke woh dhoondna aasaan ho.
Doosra, har customer ka ek fixed shelf tay kar dein, taa ke cheez hamesha usi jagah mile.
Is ko mazboot karne ke liye Workzap ye de sakta hai: phone pe die aur plate register jahan har ek ki jagah aur haalat darj ho, aur repeat order aate hi sahi die aur plate ka pata saamne aa jaye.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
